title: Extension of the Gyarfas-Sumner conjecture to digraphs (Aboulker, Charbit, Naserasr) -- Conjecture 4.2: which {digon, hero, oriented-forest} sets are heroic
_round_note: D5 round: FOUR proposals, ALL REFUTED; NO frontier advance on a bound, but TWO new structural facts narrow the residual case (one survivor isolated, one new barrier). (i) EMPIRICAL n=9 falsifier (G9): UNRESOLVED + intractable -- the load-bearing prediction (n=9 max_chi_d=2) NEVER returned a measured value (/tmp/n9_redteam.json 0 bytes; run mode prints to stdout, redirect target empty); scale ~10^11-10^12 oriented iso-free vs n=8's 575M (~2000x), at 8.5% CPU under load ~106 => months-long, NOT the 'cheap un-run falsifier' claimed; even a clean result is EVIDENCE only (gate). Only confirmed items re-ground already-ledgered facts (n=7=2142288/6751/2/null; C10(1,2,3) in-class chi_d=2). (ii) CYCLE-SUBSTITUTION CAP (G10): math CORRECT and oracle-verified (in-class C_k(parts) forces tournament parts => chi_d=2 cap; the paper's own C4-tower D_i exits the S2+ class at D_3), but DISJOINT from the open_crux: in-class cycle-substitutions live inside the already-clean exhaustive n<=8 sweep, and the residual hard case (C10(1,2,3)) is NON-substitutional, so the lemma re-explains covered territory and does NOT touch B2/H6. (iii) TWO-INTERVAL PROPERTY (G11): the 'invariant' (one linear order + one cut, both contiguous intervals acyclic) is a TAUTOLOGICAL restatement of chi_d<=2 (any 2-acyclic partition {A,B} = topo(A)++topo(B)); confirmed 0-mismatch over 92146 in-class members n<=8 BECAUSE it is identically chi_d<=2. The only theorem-bearing claim -- min-FAS back-arcs nested/crossing-width<=1 -- is FALSE: oracle-confirmed in-class C7(2,4) (i->i+2,i+4 mod 7, vertex-transitive circulant) has crossing-width>=2 at EVERY cut over ALL min-FAS orders (best min-cut width=2, max=3). NEW BARRIER B3. (iv) ROUND/IN-STAR LOCALIZATION (G12): a TRUE new structural identity (oracle-confirmed n<=6, 0 mismatches): {non-round strong in-class}=={non-locally-semicomplete strong}=={has a vertex whose in-nbhd contains an independent pair (embedded in-star S2-)}; round_count==loc_semicomplete_in_count, 8 exceptions at n=6, named n=6 witness peels to a round in-class remainder. SURVIVES as lemma-candidate H7. BUT refuted as a REDUCTION: (a) the proposed 'round => alternate-interval 2-partition' literature mechanism is FALSE on C10(1,2,3) (parity-along-round-order invalid for n=10..15; the valid 2-colouring is a single contiguous interval of size d=3, not alternation); (b) the in-star-peel induction is incomplete exactly as G7/G8 (peel verified only as 'remainder in-class', termination + reinsertion never argued uniform-in-n); (c) 'round members 2-dicolourable' merely restricts H1 to round members, not a cited theorem; (d) n=7 sweep timed out. Net: the hard burden (dense round circulant C_n<1,2,3>) is merely RELABELED, not reduced. H1 itself UNSCATHED (max chi_d=2 through n=8; C7(2,4), C10(1,2,3) both in-class chi_d=2). PRIOR (D4 round): FOUR proposals; ONE genuine frontier advance + THREE structural routes killed. (i) FRONTIER ADVANCED (empirical, confirmed+independently re-verified): the named-but-undone full-class EXHAUSTIVE n=8 red-team for Conj 6.2 is now RUN AND CLEAN, via a new iso-free pipeline scripts/full_class_redteam_directg.py (nauty geng|directg -o iso-class enumeration = 575,016,219 oriented graphs vs 2.5e9 naive labeled, infeasible). RESULT: 575,016,219 iso-free oriented graphs scanned, 85,395 in-class members, max chi_d=2, ZERO chi_d>=3 violations. Fast in-class filter (S2+-free<=>every N+(x) a tournament; ->C3-free<=>no directed triangle; digon-free by directg -o) cross-checked 0-mismatch vs core.contains_induced at n=5,6 and SAT vs exact dichromatic_number 0-mismatch; n=7 landmark reproduced (2142288/6751/2/null). H1/Conj 6.2 SURVIVES n=8 EXHAUSTIVELY; clean full-class frontier n=7->n=8. (ii) THREE structural proof MECHANISMS killed (all on the named out-local-tournament class H5): (G6) 'saturated multi-jump circulant' SMC(n,J) construction -- transitive saturation COLLAPSES every multi-jump member to the contiguous-interval circulant C_n<1..d> (d=max(J), verified n=12,16), a ROUND local tournament = the EASY single-cycle-like case, so chi_d=2 is structurally forced; targets the easy case, not the residual non-round hard case it claimed; in-class survivors only d<=~n/3 (->C3-free). (G7) 'max-acyclic-set exchange lemma' (max induced acyclic set A has acyclic complement) -- REFUTED as a proof route: the exchange step (move sink portion of cycle into A, pull subset out, get strictly-larger acyclic set) is unjustified/hand-waved with no invariant; the SHARP lemma is strictly STRONGER than chi_d<=2 (self-admitted escape hatch -- non-max splits could still give chi_d=2); min_alpha/n is a finite non-monotone observation (1.0,0.75,0.8,0.833,0.714 at n=3..7), not a derived asymptotic invariant. n=8 sweep clean for n<=7 but decisive falsifier not load-bearing. (G8) 'strong-component 2-in-degeneracy peeling' (every nontrivial SCC has a vertex of in-degree<=2) -- FALSE at n=10: C10(1,2,3) (i->i+1,i+2,i+3 mod 10) is oracle-confirmed in-class, a SINGLE SCC, 3-in/3-out-regular, girth 4, chi_d=2 -> NO low-degree seed, no peeling order; SAME transitive-triangle obstruction as graveyard G4 re-localized from global m<=2n to local min-in-deg<=2, dies one n later (n=10 vs n=7); girth>=4 'slack' present in witness and does NOT save it; proposal mis-located its own kill threshold (claimed n=8). H1 itself UNSCATHED (max chi_d=2 holds, no chi_d>=3 anywhere through n=8, plus circulant probes to n=30); only the proposed proof MECHANISMS died.
central_question: Conjecture 4.2 (Aboulker-Charbit-Naserasr). Let H be a hero (a tournament whose forbidding, with the digon and the independent pair, bounds the dichromatic number) and let F be an oriented forest. The set {K2_digon, H, F} is HEROIC -- i.e. Forb_ind({K2_digon, H, F}) has BOUNDED dichromatic number chi_d -- if and only if either (a) F is a disjoint union of oriented stars, or (b) H is a transitive tournament. The 'only if' direction is PROVED in the paper (Section 6.1, via the unbounded family Forb_ind(K2,C3,P4)); the open content is the 'if' direction when exactly one condition holds. The smallest open concrete instance is H = ->C3, F = S2+ (Conjecture 6.2: chi_d(Forb_ind(K2_digon,->C3,S2+)) = 2); the smallest PROVED instance is H = ->C3, F = ->K2+K1 (Theorem 6.1: chi_d = 2).

benchmark.description: The fixed yardstick. The invariant is the EXACT dichromatic number chi_d (least k s.t. V partitions into k acyclic sets), computed by SAT + lazy directed-cycle elimination (sound, no heuristics). For a claimed heroic set {K2_digon, H, F} with a claimed finite bound b, the oracle sweeps all oriented triangle-free digraphs up to n_max, keeps those in Forb_ind(F-extras), and reports max chi_d and any member with chi_d > b (a SOUND DISPROOF of b).
benchmark.invariant: chi_d(D) for explicit finite D = (n, arcs), exact
benchmark.oracle_cmd: problems/heroic_sets_hero_forest/.venv/bin/python scripts/oracle.py {check <n> <arcs-json> [--forbidden ...] | measure <n_max> --forbidden ... [--claimed-bound b] | thm61 [n_max] | conj62 [n_max] | tower <k> | cyclesub <k> <base>}
benchmark.oracle_api: scripts/oracle.check_construction(n, arcs, forbidden=[...]); scripts/oracle.measure_heroic_set(F_names, n_max, claimed_bound=b); scripts/oracle.thm_6_1(n_max); scripts/oracle.conj_6_2(n_max); scripts/core.{dichromatic_number, contains_induced, is_oriented, is_triangle_free, is_disjoint_union_of_oriented_stars}

forbidden_digraph_definitions.K2_digon: the digon {(0,1),(1,0)}; forbidding it induced == oriented graph
forbidden_digraph_definitions.arrowK2_K1: ->K2 + K1 = a single arc (0->1) plus an isolated vertex 2 (3 vertices, 1 arc). Forbidding it => non-neighbours of each vertex are independent => D is an orientation of a complete multipartite graph (Thm 6.1 proof).

ground_truth_landmarks.thm_6_1: PROVED EXACT: chi_d(Forb_ind(K2_digon, ->C3, ->K2+K1)) = 2. Reproduced by oracle: over oriented triangle-free Forb_ind members up to n=6, max chi_d = 2, chi_d=2 first attained at n=4 (witness = directed C4), chi_d distribution {1:504, 2:412}, no member exceeds 2.
ground_truth_landmarks.conj_6_2: OPEN: chi_d(Forb_ind(K2_digon, ->C3, S2+)) = 2 conjectured. Oracle through n=7: max chi_d = 2, first attained at n=4, distribution {1:426, 2:96}, no member exceeds 2 -- CONSISTENT (evidence, not proof).
ground_truth_landmarks.tower: chi_d(D_k) = k for the tower D_1=K1, D_m=C3(D_{m-1},D_{m-1},K1); oracle reproduces k=1..4 exactly (engine cross-check).
ground_truth_landmarks.cycle_substitution: chi_d(C_k(base)) = chi_d(base)+1 (Thm 2.1); oracle reproduces for base in {K1, K2_digon, C3}, k in {3,4}.
ground_truth_landmarks.member_count_caveat: CORRECTED (D2): the factory-brief member counts (1,3,12,68,442,3569,33697 for n=1..7 on the S2+ case) ARE now reproduced -- by scripts/full_class_redteam.py (geng WITHOUT -t, all orientations, filter induced ->C3-free & S2+-free): n=6 -> 3569, n=7 -> 33697, exact match, max chi_d=2 both. The conj62/measure oracle's smaller counts 1,3,6,20,45,130,317 are NOT a mere iso-counting CONVENTION (the D1 caveat's diagnosis was WRONG); they are a COVERAGE gap: core.oriented_triangle_free_digraphs enumerates only UNDERLYING-triangle-free digraphs (geng -t), excluding every member with a transitive triangle (e.g. all TT_k, k>=3). The dichromatic landmark (max chi_d=2, first at n=4) is invariant and holds on BOTH the subclass and the full class; but H1 evidence over the FULL class now rests on full_class_redteam.py, exhaustive through n=7.

proved.status: PROVED in the paper (cited primary source Refs/heroic_2009.13319.pdf, Sec 6.2) AND reproduced as an exact finite landmark by the oracle through n=6 (max chi_d=2, attained at n=4). Not an empirical-only claim: the paper's proof is a structural argument (no induced ->K2+K1 => complete-multipartite orientation; all induced dicycles are C4; the C4-through-a-vertex claim => 2-colourable).

proved.claim: The 'only if' direction of Conjecture 4.2: if H is a hero that is NOT a transitive tournament (so contains ->C3) and F is an oriented forest that is NOT a disjoint union of oriented stars (so its underlying graph has an induced P4), then {K2_digon, H, F} is NOT heroic.
proved.status: PROVED in the paper (Sec 6.1) via Forb_ind(K2_digon, ->C3, ->C3) containing Forb_ind(K2, C3, P4), whose chromatic (hence dichromatic) number is unbounded. Structural, not empirical.
proved.verified_by: primary source; classifier core.is_disjoint_union_of_oriented_stars encodes the 'union of oriented stars == no induced P4 in underlying' equivalence.

open_crux: The 'if' direction of Conjecture 4.2 when EXACTLY ONE condition holds -- a UNIFORM finite bound on chi_d over the infinite class Forb_ind({K2_digon, H, F}) for (H a hero, F a union of oriented stars) OR (H a transitive tournament, F any oriented forest). Smallest beachhead = Conjecture 6.2: chi_d(Forb_ind(K2_digon, ->C3, S2+)) = 2. FRONTIER STATE (D4): EMPIRICAL side is now EXHAUSTIVELY CLEAN over the CORRECT full class through n=8 -- the named falsifier is RUN (iso-free directg pipeline: 575,016,219 oriented graphs, 85,395 in-class, max chi_d=2, no chi_d>=3); plus targeted circulant families probed to n=30 (all chi_d=2). The cheaply-reachable empirical levers are EXHAUSTED -- the next un-run falsifier is full-class n=9 (directg iso-free count far larger, heavy but the pipeline makes it feasible), and any n-sweep is EVIDENCE not proof (discipline gate). STRUCTURAL side is the live problem: the class is NAMED EXACTLY -- Forb_ind(K2_digon,->C3,S2+) == {oriented, ->C3-free, OUT-LOCAL-TOURNAMENT} (H5; every N+(x) a TRANSITIVE tournament; Bang-Jensen-Huang-Prisner out-tournament theory). But EVERY proof MECHANISM tried is DEAD: functional-digraph (G1/G2); clique-contraction-to-functional/single-cycle (G3 -- chi_d-preserving, not a reduction); strong-component SPARSITY m<=2n (G4 -- false, m reaches 2.29n); round-quotient-is-single-C_k (G5 -- false, only 128/508 single-cycle at n=7); saturated multi-jump circulant SMC (G6 -- collapses to the EASY round case C_n<1..d>); max-acyclic-set exchange lemma (G7 -- unjustified exchange step, stronger-than-needed); and strong-component 2-in-DEGENERACY peeling (G8 -- FALSE at n=10, C10(1,2,3) is 3-in/3-out-regular in-class). THREE recurring barriers now stand: (B1) contracting transitive cliques is chi_d-PRESERVING, so NO clique-contraction quotient reduces H1; (B2) the residual hard case is dense (up to 3-in/3-out-regular, e.g. C10(1,2,3)), high-girth strong out-local-tournaments where NO local low-degree seed exists -- every peeling/contraction/sparsity lever provably dies here (same transitive-triangle obstruction); (B3, D5) NO min-feedback-arc-set order linearizes the back-arcs into a nested/low-crossing-width family: the in-class vertex-transitive circulant C7(2,4) has min-FAS crossing-width>=2 at EVERY cut over ALL optimal orders (chi_d=2), so the colouring shape cannot be read off a single low-width linear-order cut -- the back-arc set is irreducibly interleaved. D5 ALSO SHARPENS where 'hard' lives (survivor H7): the dense ROUND circulants (C10(1,2,3)-type) are exactly the LOCALLY-SEMICOMPLETE in-class members, and the GENUINELY non-round residual ({non-round strong}=={non-locally-semicomplete}=={vertex with an embedded in-star S2-}) is a SMALL, structurally-marked family that peels (n<=6) to a round in-class core -- BUT this is a RENAMING, not a reduction (no uniform-in-n reinsertion/termination argument, and the round core is NOT handled by any cited theorem: 'round in-class => 2-dicolourable' is just H1 restricted, and the natural alternate-interval colouring is FALSE on C10(1,2,3)). So BOTH halves are open: the round/circulant half needs a DIRECT closed-form acyclic 2-partition (single contiguous interval of size d works on C_n<1..d>, but must be proved uniform-in-n), and the small non-round half needs a sound in-star peel+reinsert INVARIANT (the gap that killed G7/G8/G12). A working proof must 2-colour the dense round circulants DIRECTLY (closed-form interval pattern, uniform in n) AND supply a uniform in-star-peel invariant for the small non-round residue; with NO low-degree peel, NO contraction, NO single-cycle reduction, NO min-FAS-order linearization. The oracle can SOUNDLY REFUTE any bound but CANNOT confirm boundedness (empirical != proof).

live_hypotheses.statement: Structural route to H1 mirroring Thm 6.1: characterize the strongly-connected members of the FULL class Forb_ind(K2_digon, ->C3, S2+) and 2-colour by decomposition. SHARPENED (D3): the class IS NOW NAMED -- it is exactly {oriented, ->C3-free, OUT-LOCAL-TOURNAMENT} (Bang-Jensen-Huang-Prisner). TWO BARRIERS (D3-D4): (B1) contracting transitive cliques is chi_d-PRESERVING (module-constant dicolouring lifts/descends; quotient chi_d == member chi_d in 0/2562 n=7 mismatches), so ANY clique-contraction quotient merely RE-EXPRESSES H1 and is not a reduction. (B2, D4) the residual hard case is the DENSE NON-ROUND strong out-local-tournament (e.g. C10(1,2,3), 3-in/3-out-regular, girth 4, in-class, chi_d=2) where NO low-degree peel (G8), NO single global cyclic order / round-decomposition (G5,G6), and NO sparsity (G4) exists. A real proof must 2-colour these DIRECTLY from their interleaved-dicycle structure (now tracked as H6).
live_hypotheses.falsifiable_prediction: If a structural decomposition 2-colours every strong out-local-tournament ->C3-free quotient DIRECTLY (without reducing to a simpler object), H1 follows. A member with chi_d>=3 (oracle-found) kills BOTH H1 and H2.

live_hypotheses.statement: RETIRED as a proof mechanism (D3): 'clique-contraction yields a functional-like / single-directed-cycle quotient governing chi_d' is DEAD. (1) Contraction is chi_d-preserving, so the quotient is not a reduction of H1 (G3). (2) The quotient is NOT a single cycle: only 128/508 strong members single-cycle at n=7; round-quotient size dist {7:128,6:156,5:112,4:112} (G5). (3) Quotient is not even locally semicomplete at n>=6. SURVIVING POSITIVE residue folded into H5: the EXACT class identity and N+(x)-transitive lemma.
live_hypotheses.falsifiable_prediction: (killed -- see G3/G5). No further test; superseded by H5.

live_hypotheses.statement: LEMMA-CANDIDATE (D3, durable positive): Forb_ind(K2_digon, ->C3, S2+) == {oriented, ->C3-free, OUT-LOCAL-TOURNAMENT} digraphs EXACTLY, and equivalently every out-neighbourhood N+(x) induces a TRANSITIVE tournament. Oracle-verified n<=6 (145252 oriented digraphs, 0 exceptions); re-confirmed implicitly by the D4 iso-free pipeline whose fast filter (S2+-free<=>every N+(x) a tournament) matched core.contains_induced 0-mismatch at n=5,6. This is a STRUCTURAL fact (not just empirical: S2+-free <=> N+(x) is a tournament is a one-line class-definition equivalence; (digon+->C3)-free forces transitivity), giving a literature hook (Bang-Jensen-Huang-Prisner JCTB 1993 out-tournament structure). It does NOT by itself bound chi_d (all reductions built on it died, G3/G4/G5/G6/G7/G8), but it is the correct NAME of the class and the starting point for any direct 2-colouring of the strong quotient.
live_hypotheses.falsifiable_prediction: Every member of the full class is an oriented ->C3-free out-local-tournament with all N+(x) transitive. A member with a non-transitive (i.e. non-tournament, hence S2+ present -- contradiction) or non-out-local-tournament N+(x) while in-class would refute the identity. None found through n=8.
live_hypotheses.test: scripts/h4_clique_contraction.py / scripts/ground_outlocal_reduction.py: per-member check N+(x) is a transitive tournament AND in_class == (oriented & ->C3-free & out-local-tournament)

live_hypotheses.statement: DIRECT-2-COLOURING TARGET (D4; SHARPENED D5 into a precise two-half split via H7). The live structural problem splits into TWO open halves: (HALF A, the dense ROUND/circulant half) bound chi_d<=2 on the dense round (= locally-semicomplete) strong out-local-tournaments, CONCRETE MODEL C10(1,2,3) (i->i+1,i+2,i+3 mod 10): in-class, single SCC, 3-in/3-out-REGULAR, girth 4, vertex-transitive, chi_d=2 -- needs a CLOSED-FORM acyclic 2-partition uniform in n. D5 OBSERVED a candidate: for C_n<1..d> a SINGLE contiguous interval of size d (and its complement) is 2-dicolourable on the oracle (50 valid interval-partitions on C10(1,2,3)); the WRONG candidate alternate-interval/parity-along-round-order is FALSE (invalid n=10..15) -- so the rule is 'one contiguous arc of length d', which must be PROVED acyclic for all n. (HALF B, the small NON-ROUND residue, marked by H7) supply a uniform-in-n in-star peel+reinsert INVARIANT for the structurally-marked non-round members (those with a vertex whose in-nbhd has an independent pair); peeling that vertex gives an in-class remainder (verified n<=6) but termination in the round core and reinsertion into a 2-dicolouring are NOT argued -- the exact gap that killed G7/G8/G12. NEW BARRIER B3 (D5): the colouring shape canNOT be read off a min-FAS linear-order cut (C7(2,4) has crossing-width>=2 at every cut over all optimal orders), so neither half is solvable by linearization. NOT via peeling-by-low-degree, contraction, sparsity, round-quotient-as-single-cycle, or min-FAS linearization (all dead).
live_hypotheses.falsifiable_prediction: If (HALF A) a closed-form contiguous-interval acyclic 2-partition is PROVED for all dense round in-class circulants C_n<1..d> AND (HALF B) a uniform in-star-peel invariant closes the small non-round residue, H1 follows and can enter 'proved'. Sub-falsifier for HALF A: some in-class C_n<1..d> for which NO single contiguous interval (and complement) is a valid 2-dicolouring would kill the contiguous-interval rule. CONVERSELY an oracle-found in-class member (any n) with chi_d>=3 kills H1/H2/H6/H7 outright.
live_hypotheses.test: scripts/full_class_redteam_directg.py run <n> for chi_d>=3 falsification; for HALF A: enumerate in-class circulants C_n<1..d>, test the single-contiguous-interval-of-length-d 2-partition for n up to 30 then PROVE acyclic uniformly; for HALF B: characterize the non-round (= non-loc-semicomplete = embedded-in-star) members and seek a peel+reinsert invariant

graveyard.claim: Lemma A (structural-closure route): every D in Forb_ind(K2_digon, ->C3, S2+) has max out-degree <= 1, i.e. is a functional digraph; hence chi_d<=2 by functional-digraph theory.
graveyard.kill_reason: FALSE at n=3: TT_k (transitive tournament) is in_Forb_ind (no digon, no ->C3, no induced S2+) with out-degree k-1, oracle-confirmed (TT3 out-deg 2, TT4 out-deg 3). Flaw: conjecture forbids only the DIRECTED ->C3, not the undirected/transitive triangle, so out-neighbourhood cliques can be transitive tournaments of any size.
